media.invalidOrTooLarge: image is invalid or exceeds the local size limit

member.lastActive: household must retain at least one active member

onboarding.memberRequired: at least one member is required

ownership.atLeastOneOwner: at least one owner is required
ownership.duplicateOwner: an owner may appear only once

ownership.percentageFormat: percentage must be between 0 and 100 with at most two decimals

provider.malformedResponse: The provider returned an invalid response
provider.rateLimit: The provider rate limit was reached
provider.responseTooLarge: The provider response is too large

quote.baseCurrencyRequired: currency pair must include the Household base currency
quote.currencyPairDifferent: base and quote currencies must differ

reference.groupInactive: group is not an active reference
reference.institutionInactive: institution is not an active reference

settings.separatorsMatch: decimal and grouping separators must differ

validation.calculationRange: calculation is outside the supported range
validation.currencyFormat: must contain exactly three uppercase letters
validation.fxRateFormat: must be a canonical positive decimal with up to twelve fractional digits
validation.moneyFormat: must be a canonical non-negative decimal with up to four fractional digits
